description: This file defines the EntityAccessChecker class, which centralizes access control logic for entities in Drupal's JSON:API module, including handling revision and label access checks.

classes.name: EntityAccessChecker
classes.description: A class that manages access checks for entities in Drupal's JSON:API, including revision and label access logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EntityAccessChecker with resource type repository, router, current user, and entity repository.

methods.name: setLatestRevisionCheck
methods.description: Sets the service used to check access to the latest revision of an entity, used when content moderation is installed.

methods.name: getAccessCheckedResourceObject
methods.description: Returns a ResourceObject or LabelOnlyResourceObject for an entity if access is granted, or throws an access denied exception.

methods.name: checkEntityAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for a specific operation on an entity, including revision checks if applicable.

methods.name: checkRevisionViewAccess
methods.description: Checks access to view a specific revision of an entity, integrating content moderation logic.
